title: The board and the warehouse disagree
summary: A consignment the customer cancelled on Monday was picked and loaded on Tuesday, and the dispatch board had it waiting for a picker all morning. Repairing the board brought back two consignments that had gone missing from it, both showing no parcels, and left another one showing twice the parcels it holds.

checkpoints.title: The board agrees with the consignments after every change
checkpoints.hint: Every write path in `consignments.ts` tells the board what it did, except one. A board that hears about four changes out of five is wrong for as long as nobody looks, which is the failure this whole workout is about.

checkpoints.title: A change the relay delivers twice counts once
checkpoints.hint: `parcel_count + 1` is a delta, and a delta applied twice counts twice. The row is derived from the consignment and its parcels, so read it off them instead: count and sum on every change, and write with `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (consignment_id) DO UPDATE SET ...` so the second delivery lands where the first one did.

checkpoints.title: A rebuild repairs a board that has drifted
checkpoints.hint: The rebuild only adds rows that are missing, so a row holding the wrong numbers keeps them and a row for a consignment that is not there stays on the board. Recompute every consignment's row from the consignment tables, and take off whatever the consignments do not account for.

checkpoints.title: The board page still reads only the board
checkpoints.hint: This one passes at the start. If it broke, `listBoard` is reading `consignment` or `parcel` again: joining at render time answers the same question and gives up the reason the board table exists. Keep it one read of `board_row`.
